immutable_target: Complete consolidated W01-W04/F01-F08 first-vertical implementation preparation: executable tests/oracles/fault/load/proof harnesses, exact source/owner interfaces, build closure and meaningful RED admissions; independent final review
mutation_boundary: Tests/design/evidence only by default. Any tooling implementation, generated/lockfile change requires separately recorded exact clean RED admission and serialized owner; no product implementation without an admitted lane. Main94 staged paths preserved.
pre_mortem: Test counts substitute for reached behavior; synthetic fixture proves itself; deferred failures admitted as behavioral RED; green static specs mislabeled product tests; privileged fixture bypasses actual owner boundary; legacy architectures followed without evidence.
detection: Known-bad mutations rejected by the designated oracle
Exact Git source identities and failure classifications
Independent security/workflows/operations reviews with fixes and final exactSHA
blast_radius: One preparation writer and independent read-only reviewers; isolated disposable runtime; serial shared/generated/authority records.
rollback: Retain all approved/superseded commits and raw evidence; no destructive shared-workspace Git; stop owned runtime after use.
stop_conditions: Unresolved material contradiction requires design reconciliation before dependent changes
Environment failure cannot be implementation RED
No fabricated policy grants, publisher custody, legal or deployment proof
Finish only when consolidated preparation acceptance is independently reviewed, with later runtime/deployment proof explicitly bounded
later_proof_not_prep_completion: Implemented owner behavior GREEN and mutation resistance
Measured production-scale capacity and failure-domain recovery
Real deployment keys/provider custody/legal content authority
